description: Complete feature graph for Opal — every module, integration, and capability from MVP through long-term platform vision. Used by the Opal Feature Explorer wireframe.

nodes.title: Lead vendors
nodes.subtitle: purchased and organic sources
nodes.description: External lead vendors, marketing agencies, web traffic, and organic referral sources that deliver new prospects.

nodes.title: Carrier portals
nodes.subtitle: existing eApp + UW sites
nodes.description: The patchwork of carrier-owned eApp portals, illustration tools, and underwriting status pages that exist today. Opal interacts with these via browser extension before any direct API exists.

nodes.title: Agent input
nodes.subtitle: manual edits and data entry
nodes.description: The agent typing data directly into Opal — phone calls, observations, corrections, and ad-hoc notes.

nodes.title: Auth & accounts
nodes.subtitle: user identity, sessions
nodes.description: User authentication, session management, password reset, MFA, and account lifecycle. Every other module assumes a logged-in identity.

nodes.title: Contact + PII model
nodes.subtitle: single source of truth
nodes.description: Persistent contact aggregate: PII, demographics, related activities, qualifications, quotes, applications, policies, documents. The data spine of the entire platform.

nodes.title: Activity log
nodes.subtitle: events, timeline, audit
nodes.description: Append-only event log for every action taken against a contact: calls, SMS, emails, notes, status changes, quotes generated, applications submitted.

nodes.title: Document storage
nodes.subtitle: files, recordings, IDs
nodes.description: S3-style object storage for call recordings, signed forms, ID images, illustrations, and any other binary artifacts attached to contacts.

nodes.title: Audit trail
nodes.subtitle: compliance and replay
nodes.description: Immutable, regulator-grade trail of who did what when. Required for state and federal life/health compliance, replay-of-record requests, and dispute resolution.

nodes.title: Roles & permissions
nodes.subtitle: agent, manager, admin
nodes.description: Role-based access control: producer, agency manager, IMO admin, carrier observer, customer-portal user.

nodes.title: Multi-tenant
nodes.subtitle: agency hierarchy and isolation
nodes.description: Tenant isolation for agencies, IMOs, and downline structures. Required for any scenario where data must be scoped to an org rather than an individual.

nodes.title: Notifications
nodes.subtitle: in-app, email, push, SMS
nodes.description: Cross-channel notification system for tasks, alerts, status changes, and time-sensitive events.

nodes.title: CSV lead import
nodes.subtitle: drag, drop, dedupe
nodes.description: CSV/Excel file upload with column mapping, validation, and duplicate detection against existing contacts.

nodes.title: Embed forms
nodes.subtitle: hosted intake forms
nodes.description: Customizable hosted forms agents can embed in landing pages. Submissions create contacts directly.

nodes.title: Webhook intake
nodes.subtitle: Zapier and direct POST
nodes.description: Generic webhook endpoint for any lead source that can POST JSON. Foundation for vendor integrations and Zapier-style flows.

nodes.title: Vendor APIs
nodes.subtitle: direct integrations
nodes.description: First-party integrations with major lead vendors for real-time delivery, ROI tracking, and refund/return workflows.

nodes.title: Single-line dialer
nodes.subtitle: click to call, Twilio
nodes.description: Outbound calling via Twilio (or similar) with click-to-call, call disposition, and caller-ID rotation.

nodes.title: Power dialer
nodes.subtitle: parallel and predictive
nodes.description: Multi-line parallel dialer with abandonment management. Substantially harder than single-line and regulated separately.

nodes.title: SMS messaging
nodes.subtitle: two-way text, templates
nodes.description: Compliant two-way SMS with templates, opt-out handling, and 10DLC registration.

nodes.title: Email integration
nodes.subtitle: Gmail, Outlook, sync
nodes.description: OAuth-based bidirectional sync with Gmail and Outlook. Email threads attach to contacts automatically.

nodes.title: Voicemail drop
nodes.subtitle: pre-recorded VM
nodes.description: Pre-recorded voicemail injection on no-answer, with multiple recordings per agent and per campaign.

nodes.title: Call recording
nodes.subtitle: stored, indexed, replayable
nodes.description: Full call recording with two-party consent handling, storage in document layer, and per-state compliance toggles.

nodes.title: AI transcription
nodes.subtitle: real-time speech-to-text
nodes.description: Real-time transcription of live calls with speaker diarization. Drives the AI extraction layer.

nodes.title: AI field extraction
nodes.subtitle: transcript to PII
nodes.description: LLM-powered extraction of structured fields (DOB, height/weight, medications, beneficiaries, etc.) from call transcripts and notes, written back to the contact record.

nodes.title: Pipeline / CRM
nodes.subtitle: kanban stages and views
nodes.description: Customizable pipeline stages, kanban and list views, contact filtering, bulk actions.

nodes.title: Today queue
nodes.subtitle: prioritized call list
nodes.description: AI-prioritized daily call queue based on scheduled callbacks, lead freshness, and stage urgency.

nodes.title: Tasks & follow-ups
nodes.subtitle: reminders, SLAs
nodes.description: Task creation, due dates, snoozing, recurring tasks, and SLA tracking against contact stages.

nodes.title: Drip sequences
nodes.subtitle: automated SMS + email
nodes.description: Multi-step automated sequences mixing SMS, email, and tasks. Triggered by stage change, time delay, or custom events.

nodes.title: Lead scoring
nodes.subtitle: AI-assisted prioritization
nodes.description: Predictive scoring of lead conversion probability based on contact attributes, source, and historical patterns.

nodes.title: Term life quoting
nodes.subtitle: live multi-carrier compare
nodes.description: Real-time term life quoting across all major carriers. Highest-volume product type for healthy applicants.

nodes.title: Final expense
nodes.subtitle: FE / GI quoting
nodes.description: Final expense and guaranteed-issue quoting. Different rate structure and underwriting from term life.

nodes.title: IUL / WL quoting
nodes.subtitle: cash-value products
nodes.description: Indexed universal life and whole life quoting. Requires illustration generation for compliant presentation.

nodes.title: Medicare quoting
nodes.subtitle: MAPD, MS, PDP
nodes.description: Medicare Advantage, Medicare Supplement, and Part D quoting. Plan-year-bound and integrated with CMS data.

nodes.title: ACA quoting
nodes.subtitle: marketplace plans
nodes.description: ACA marketplace plan quoting with subsidy calculation. Requires HealthSherpa or similar integration.

nodes.title: Quote comparison
nodes.subtitle: side-by-side, save, share
nodes.description: Unified comparison view across all quoted products with save, share, and present-on-call modes.

nodes.title: Illustrations
nodes.subtitle: compliant cash-value illos
nodes.description: Carrier-compliant illustration generation for cash-value products. Required for sale of IUL/WL.

nodes.title: UW cheat sheet
nodes.subtitle: rules engine, build chart
nodes.description: Curated underwriting reference: build chart, common conditions, foreign travel rules, occupation/avocation. The 90-percent solution.

nodes.title: Rx pre-qual
nodes.subtitle: AI prescription matching
nodes.description: AI-driven prescription history pre-qualifier (BPP-style) that predicts carrier acceptance from medication patterns. The long-term moat.

nodes.title: eApp autofill ext
nodes.subtitle: browser extension
nodes.description: Chrome/Edge browser extension that recognizes carrier eApp portal fields and autofills from the contact record. The cheat code that gives day-one carrier coverage with zero carrier cooperation.

nodes.title: Native eApp
nodes.subtitle: API-direct submission
nodes.description: Direct API submission to carriers that expose eApp APIs. Replaces extension where available. Requires carrier-by-carrier integration.

nodes.title: Middleware handoff
nodes.subtitle: iPipeline, Firelight
nodes.description: Integration with eApp middleware aggregators (iPipeline, Firelight) as a fallback for carriers reachable that way.

nodes.title: e-Signature
nodes.subtitle: DocuSign, Adobe, native
nodes.description: e-Signature flow for application forms, replacement notices, HIPAA authorizations.

nodes.title: Doc collection
nodes.subtitle: IDs, photos, uploads
nodes.description: Mobile-friendly document upload flows for IDs, void checks, and supplementary forms. Customer can complete from a text link.

nodes.title: Voice signature
nodes.subtitle: FE phone-sale signatures
nodes.description: Voice-recorded signature capture for telephonic final-expense sales where eSignature isn't feasible.

nodes.title: Submission tracker
nodes.subtitle: what was sent where
nodes.description: Tracks every application submitted, to which carrier, with what status, including extension-submitted apps.

nodes.title: Outstanding reqs
nodes.subtitle: what each app needs next
nodes.description: Dashboard of every pending requirement across every open application: APS, exam, payment, sig, etc.

nodes.title: Policy status
nodes.subtitle: issued, in force, lapsed
nodes.description: Status feed for in-force policies. Sourced from carrier portals via extension scraping initially, native APIs later.

nodes.title: Commission ingest
nodes.subtitle: PDF and CSV statements
nodes.description: Ingest commission statements from carriers in PDF/CSV format and reconcile to policies.

nodes.title: Commission recon
nodes.subtitle: expected vs paid
nodes.description: Reconciliation engine that flags chargebacks, missing payments, and rate-mismatch errors against expected commissions.

nodes.title: Persistency
nodes.subtitle: policy survival tracking
nodes.description: Cohort-based persistency reporting: 13-month, 25-month, by carrier, by product, by lead source.

nodes.title: Cross-sell triggers
nodes.subtitle: renewal and life events
nodes.description: Automated triggers for cross-sell opportunities based on policy events, renewals, and life-event signals.

nodes.title: Customer portal
nodes.subtitle: white-label client view
nodes.description: Client-facing portal where the policyholder can view active policies, request changes, and message their agent.

nodes.title: Appointments
nodes.subtitle: carrier appointment status
nodes.description: Tracks carrier appointment status per agent: which carriers, ready-to-sell dates, JIT vs full appointment.

nodes.title: License tracking
nodes.subtitle: state licenses, renewals
nodes.description: State life/health license tracking with renewal alerts and document storage.

nodes.title: CE & E&O
nodes.subtitle: continuing ed, E&O
nodes.description: Continuing education credits and Errors & Omissions insurance tracking with expiration alerts.

nodes.title: Contracting flow
nodes.subtitle: SureLC replacement
nodes.description: Native carrier-contracting workflow. Phase-3 wedge into IMOs since contracting today flows through SureLC and similar.

nodes.title: Agent dashboard
nodes.subtitle: personal production view
nodes.description: Daily/weekly/monthly production dashboard: calls, contacts, quotes, apps submitted, apps issued, commission.

nodes.title: Funnel analytics
nodes.subtitle: stage conversion
nodes.description: Conversion analytics across pipeline stages, identifying drop-off points and time-in-stage outliers.

nodes.title: Lead ROI
nodes.subtitle: source, cost, conversion
nodes.description: ROI by lead source: cost per lead, conversion rate, average premium, payback period, persistency.

nodes.title: Call analytics
nodes.subtitle: talk time, dispositions
nodes.description: Call performance analytics: talk time, contact rate, conversion by hour/day/state.

nodes.title: Carrier conversion
nodes.subtitle: by carrier and product
nodes.description: Conversion rate, average premium, and decline rate by carrier and by product class.

nodes.title: Anon benchmarks
nodes.subtitle: industry comparison
nodes.description: Anonymized comparison of agent metrics against the broader Opal user base. Network-effect feature.

nodes.title: Team visibility
nodes.subtitle: downline production
nodes.description: Manager and IMO views into downline production, pipeline, and call activity.

nodes.title: Override tracking
nodes.subtitle: splits and overrides
nodes.description: Hierarchical override and split-commission calculation across agency tiers.

nodes.title: Agent recruiting
nodes.subtitle: hire pipeline
nodes.description: Recruiting funnel for adding agents to an IMO or agency: outreach, contracting, ramp tracking.

nodes.title: Training
nodes.subtitle: modules and certs
nodes.description: In-platform training modules, role-plays, certification tracking for new and existing agents.

nodes.title: Agency branding
nodes.subtitle: white-label and custom domain
nodes.description: White-label theming and custom-domain support for agencies that want Opal-branded-as-them.

nodes.title: Lead exchange
nodes.subtitle: shared marketplace
nodes.description: Two-sided lead marketplace where vendors list inventory and producers buy with full ROI transparency. Endgame ARR pillar.

nodes.title: Carrier end-to-end
nodes.subtitle: full bidirectional integration
nodes.description: Full integration with a single carrier covering eApp submission, underwriting status, policy issuance, commission feeds, and contracting. Tier-4 carrier integration; the proof point that feeds the open API standard.

nodes.title: Carrier API standard
nodes.subtitle: open submission spec
nodes.description: Open specification for eApp/UW/contracting APIs that carriers adopt as a result of producer-side leverage. The reason every prior attempt failed and Opal's largest long-term moat.

nodes.title: Producer directory
nodes.subtitle: verified, neutral
nodes.description: Verified producer directory: licenses, appointments, persistency, ratings. Powers IMO recruiting and consumer-facing referrals.

nodes.title: Industry data
nodes.subtitle: anonymized data products
nodes.description: Productized anonymized data feeds for carriers, IMOs, and reinsurers: real submission patterns, competitive win/loss, market shift signals.

edges.rationale: Tier 4 — adds full bidirectional flow per carrier.
End-to-end requires the policy data flow back.
End-to-end requires the commission data flow back.
Tier 5 — generalize the proven end-to-end into an open standard.
Tier 2 — AI/data-driven version of the same UW capability.
Tier 3 — compliant illustration on top of comparison.
Tier 3 — comparison against the broader Opal base.

presets.title: Lean MVP
presets.description: Producer-installable workspace, no carrier or IMO dependency. The agent's daily call-flow loop.

presets.title: Full agent workspace
presets.description: MVP plus advanced capture, full quoting suite, commission tracking, and personal analytics.

presets.title: Agency / IMO edition
presets.description: Full agent workspace plus multi-tenant hierarchy, override tracking, recruiting, and white-label.

presets.title: Industry platform
presets.description: Everything. The full network/marketplace endgame including carrier API standardization.

ladders.title: Carrier integration
ladders.description: Depth of integration with each carrier, from client-side autofill to a shared open API standard.

ladders.title: UW intelligence
ladders.description: Underwriting prediction, from rules-based reference to data-driven AI matching.

ladders.title: Quote depth
ladders.description: Quoting capability, from instant rate quotes to compliant cash-value illustrations.

ladders.title: Capture intelligence
ladders.description: Information extracted from a phone conversation, from raw audio to structured PII.

ladders.title: Lead intake automation
ladders.description: Lead intake mechanism, from manual file upload to a two-sided marketplace.

ladders.title: Reporting depth
ladders.description: Analytics scope, from one agent's metrics to industry-wide data products.

ladders.title: Commission handling
ladders.description: Commission tracking, from raw statement ingest to expected-vs-paid reconciliation.

ladders.title: Dialer throughput
ladders.description: Outbound dialing, from one line at a time to multi-line parallel.
